module.name: holoscan-mono-depth
module.description: Monocular depth estimation on the GPU: a CUDA resize and normalization into the model's input, TensorRT through the SDK's HoloInfer, and a CUDA resample of the output back onto the image, as relative inverse depth, optional metric depth and an optional colorized image for HoloViz. Made for Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0), which is not included: a tool exports it to ONNX.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, with TensorRT 10.

data.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0)
data.description: Not part of this module. Its tools/prepare_model.py downloads the pinned checkpoint from Hugging Face and exports it to ONNX with a separately installed PyTorch and Transformers. The Base and Large checkpoints it can also export are CC-BY-NC-4.0, for non-commercial use only. The tests use a stub model that the module writes itself.
